title: Unit Event — Halt! Tenma's on the Case — Episode4 After That Ninja!

meta.Event Outline: At Kijima's suggestion, Tsukasa has been putting on muscle to increase his acting chops. He and the others arrive at the Jidaigeki Studio Park with the Mikazukigumi troupe, but news of a theft puts the new production on hold...and that's when Tsukasa spots a suspicious ninja on the lot!

rows.Line: Hiori Jidaigeki Studio Park - Main Street

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What's taking Tsukasa so long?
Do you think he's having trouble finding those dango?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That warehouse is pretty big...
Maybe I should've gone with him...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hmm...
He did take his phone with him, so why don't we send him a message...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: You're wanted for arrest!!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Stop right there!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, it's Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I knew it...!
Also, arrest? What's he talking about...?
se_event_torimonothou_2024_003

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa!
A ninja just ran thataway!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thief! Cease! And! Desist!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa's chasing after the ninja!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Perhaps that ninja is the thief who's been plaguing this park...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! That ninja's the thief?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, he might be right...!
Tsukasa even called him a thief just now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, we gotta chase after him!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene, you go tell the nearby park staff about our possible suspect.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, got it!
se_run_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Stop right there!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Darn it...!
I thought I would've caught him by now since he didn't get much of a lead on me.)
se_event_torimonothou_2024_003

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But this ninja thief's quick...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (My training with Mikazukigumi has made me a much faster runner...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I'm so close...!
He's right in front of me...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(...!
I got a hand on his outfit, but I can't stop him!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Hm? The back of this ninja's hand...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(...!
It's always crowded outside of the magistrate's office! At this rate...)
se_event_torimonothou_2024_003

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Grr...!
I lost him! He's somewhere in this crowd...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (However, I'll surely be able to pick him out with the way he's dressed! Where is he...?)

rows.Speaker: Ninja Cast Member A
rows.Line:
Attention, everyone!
The ninja class will be starting soon!

rows.Speaker: Ninja Cast Member B
rows.Line: We ask those who wish to learn the way of the ninja to please gather here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
N-Now there are ninjas everywhere...

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Wow, that sounds like fun!
I wanna go, Mommy!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Yes, it does look like fun.
Why don't we go learn together?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Too many people are gathering!
This is bad...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No...
I completely lost him...
Mikazukigumi Practice Area

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
I see...
You spotted him in the warehouse and gave chase, but lost sight of him...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes...
I feel so ashamed...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
No, don't be.
It took great courage for you to try to catch him after seeing him.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: However, we don't know what he might do when he's backed into a corner. So, please refrain from trying to catch him on your own next time...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Be sure to ask a nearby adult or security guard.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa looks really sad...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I understand how he must feel...
He was so close to catching the thief.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I was so close. If only I were able to run a little faster, then I might've been able to catch him...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And me catching him would've meant us being able to resume doing our performances...!)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Still, Tenma, you've provided us with an incredibly valuable clue.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Our thief operating while disguised as a ninja. Knowing that is massive.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But what if he decides to change or remove his disguise...? We wouldn't be able to identify him then...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Actually, there are only a couple designated places in this park where people are able to dress as ninjas.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: One is the changing rooms for the cast. The other is the ninja village, which is approximately where your chase ended, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: One of my troupe members just happened to be over there when Kusanagi sent me that message. I'm having them keep an eye out for anyone going to change outfits.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: However, no one besides children seems to have changed. Which means...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There's a good chance that the ninja is still wearing the same outfit?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Exactly.
Now, we can't rule out the possibility that our perp is a member of the cast.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: But based on what the staff just told me, no one has changed since that time. They even have security camera footage to back up this claim.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That ninja is still somewhere in the park...?!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Yeah, I think so.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Naturally, he could change outside of the changing rooms, but there aren't many places in the park where you could do so out of sight. Not to mention how the entrances and exits to the bathrooms and the park itself are monitored by security cameras.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right... Which means...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (We still have a chance to catch him...!)

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member
rows.Line:
Still...
What does he want with that prop?

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member
rows.Line:
Good question.
It's not like it's worth anything.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I have a feeling that he mistook it for the pot that's supposed to be on exhibit here tomorrow. The one in this flyer.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What's this?
“See the renowned Kikuo Fujino's ceramic pots here at Jidaigeki Studio Park!”...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, he thought it was a priceless piece of art...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That would be my guess.
He saw a similar pot in the part of the warehouse we're borrowing and had a misunderstanding.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member
rows.Line:
So, he's not a very good thief...?
I mean, why would anyone leave a priceless piece of art in a warehouse like that...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
However, he's quick. Very quick.
Just like Chusuke the swift-footed thief.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: All this to say, let's keep warning the guests about what's been going on while keeping an eye out for him and trying to find that pot.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: He may've stashed the pot away somewhere, but odds are high that he's still dressed as a ninja.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: So, let's split up and look for any suspicious-looking ninjas. We'll patrol the ninja village, main street and tea district.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: You and the others will take the main street, Tenma, but please be careful.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We will!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Alright, ninja...!
I'm going to catch you no matter what...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, we're back where we all were when we saw that thieving ninja, but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... How do we actually go about finding him...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which way did he go when you were chasing after him, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That way.
But there's a four-way intersection up ahead...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
He could've gone in any direction...
So we really have no leads besides the possibility that he's still dressed as a ninja.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which means we'll have to do some good old-fashioned detective work...
<Oh, you all look so concerned. Is something wrong?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Luka! What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Remember how you told us that you'd be doing your next show at the Jidaigeki Studio Park?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I wanted to see what it's like...
So, I decided to come take a look♪>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But I began to wonder what was going on based on your troubled expressions.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, so!
This ninja thief stole a prop pot!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <A prop pot...? A ninja thief...?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She's gonna need a little more information, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We may want to start from the beginning here. The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: ...which is why we're now looking for that thieving ninja and the pot he stole.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We were just trying to come up with a way to find him since we're basically out of leads.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, I see...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We believe that he's hidden among the guests and cast members dressed as ninjas.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, as time-consuming as this is likely going to be, our best option may be to talk to everyone we see who's wearing a similar outfit.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, how are we gonna know that we're talking to the real ninja thief?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I think I've got that covered.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I just recalled something, and already let Mr. Kijima know...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: While I was chasing him, I noticed these scars on the back of his right hand. Three lines like a cat scratched him or something.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, if it's him, we'll know once we've seen his hand.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see. That's good to know.
It saves us the trouble of having to get everyone's alibis.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Right!
Now we just have to find him!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But this place is huge...
Just finding people dressed as ninjas is gonna be really hard.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
True.
We're dealing with a big crowd and poor visibility.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I wish there were a more efficient way to investigate, but we'll just have to look at everyone we come across...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If only I'd brought one of my drones...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh...♪
Hehe. I just thought of a wonderful idea.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? A wonderful idea?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Yes♪
Umm... Emu, would you mind lending me a hand?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Me?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Yes!
My idea should make it much easier to find this ninja thief♪>
